- TOTAL revenue TW was £61.8k versus LW £55.3k, a WoW increase of 11.8%.
- TOTAL units sold rose to 21,178 TW from 18,670 LW, while TOTAL orders held nearly flat at 1,154 TW versus 1,153 LW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led all products TW with £8.4k revenue, a 13.6% share of TOTAL revenue.
- EDWARDIAN PARASOL BLACK generated £3.4k TW revenue, holding a 5.6% share.
- FAIRY CAKE CANDLES posted £3.1k TW revenue with a 5.0% share.
- RED/WHITE DOTS RUFFLED UMBRELLA recorded £3.0k TW revenue, a 4.9% share, close to EDWARDIAN PARASOL NATURAL at £2.9k and 4.7% share.
- BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME had the largest WoW revenue increase among products at 185.5%.
- WILLOW BRANCH LIGHTS. and CHICK GREY HOT WATER BOTTLE also saw strong WoW revenue gains of 185.0% and 155.1% respectively.
